rules.title: S.2983 – An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: Senate bill reported by the Committee on Housing on March 12, 2026 and now before Senate Ways and Means. Its title and the committee report describe it as legislation to prohibit algorithmic rent setting, combining petitions S.994 and S.1016 (the Preventing Algorithmic Rent Fixing in the Rental Housing Market Act). The page does not include the bill text, so no prohibited conduct, penalties, coverage or effective date is stated.
rules.effective_date_note: Bill is pending in Senate Ways and Means; no effective date is stated.
